about: #2616, #2783: production's text, measured on production's answers with this checkout's server. Written by test/text-bound-live.mjs --record. tools: the production-wide tools (exposure_radar, cve_summary), held to MARGIN from this record, their answers kept in fixtures/prod-answers/ (written only from scripts/probe-prod.sh). tools.*.measured_at is when this checkout's server last measured the kept answers and answers_read_at when they were read from production (#2822); a re-measure of the kept answers (--answers test/fixtures/prod-answers) moves measured_at, never answers_read_at. cases: every case of text-bound.mjs SHAPED, each tool at its default call and largest page, held to the ceiling, and text-bound.test.mjs holds each SHAPED case within SHAPED_DRIFT of its record here; source says where the answers came from (probe-prod, or the hosted endpoint, replayed, or for exposure_radar and cve_intel the hosted endpoint's own text). structured (#3013, since 3.0.0's re-record): the same answer's structuredContent as compact JSON, what Claude Code hands the model, held to STRUCTURED_BUDGET (30,000); a case recorded before carries none.
